title: jmap-server: split JmapBackend reads into their own trait with DelegateJmapReads (chat-backend-split phase 2)
description: Decision 39: after phase 1 (JMAP-it7g.6) is in use in mimid. Reads: get_objects, get_state, get_changes, query_objects, query_changes; the rest (account_exists, principal_id, accept_language, max_objects_*, metadata_info, i18n_info) stay. Touches every family server's impls. Design: docs/design/chat-backend-split.md §3.4, §6.
